lines.text: Same lunch. Fine on Monday. Rough on Thursday.
Gut researchers at Monash University describe it more like a cup than a switch.
Each food adds a little. Eat a few close together, and they stack up.
And other things can add to it too.
A short night. A stressful week. The days around your period.
So on Thursday, the same lunch is the drop that spills it.
It was never just the lunch. It was everything in the cup.
Get Regular logs your meals, sleep, stress and cycle side by side, so you can see what fills yours.
